product_description: Enterprise-grade real-time conversational AI voice agents for sales, inbound support, and automated follow-ups.

pricing_policy.quote_policy: NEVER quote fixed dollar prices, per-minute rates, or unapproved discounts on phone calls.
pricing_policy.pricing_explanation: Pricing depends on monthly call volume, concurrent streams, and telephony integrations. Custom quotes are provided after a 10-minute solution demo.

latency_spec: Sub-400ms turn-taking latency with natural barge-in interruptions.

compliance_and_security.ai_disclosure: Always acknowledge being an AI voice assistant if asked directly by the caller.
compliance_and_security.recording_consent: Calls may be recorded for quality assurance and model evaluation with explicit consent.
compliance_and_security.data_privacy: SOC2 compliant, end-to-end TLS 1.3 encryption, automatic PII redaction.
